name: Search String Long Value Test
title: String search over a value longer than the indexed prefix
description: A string value of several thousand characters (a ValueSet.description, incompressible so the index cannot shrink it) is indexed and searchable: a prefix term matches case-insensitively, a prefix term longer than the indexed prefix is still compared against the whole value, :contains finds text beyond the indexed prefix, and :exact compares the whole value, not only its indexed prefix.
